info.0: Neapolitan pizza is the version of the round pizza typically prepared in the Italian city of Naples.
info.1: and characterised by a soft, thin dough with high edges.
info.2: The tomatoes are traditionally either San Marzano tomatoes or pomodorini del Piennolo del Vesuvio.

pizza.name: Margherita
pizza.description: A timeless classic, the Margherita pizza offers a simple yet rich combination of fresh tomato sauce, creamy mozzarella, and fragrant basil leaves. Light, fresh, and full of traditional Italian flavor.

pizza.name: Pepperoni
pizza.description: A great classic with a bold taste, this pizza is topped with layers of spicy pepperoni, melted mozzarella, and a flavorful tomato base. Crispy edges and a smoky note make every bite irresistible.

pizza.name: BBQ Chicken
pizza.description: A flavorful twist on tradition: the BBQ Chicken pizza combines tender grilled chicken breast, smoky BBQ sauce, caramelized onions, and melted mozzarella. Perfect for those who love a sweet and smoky taste.

pizza.name: Hawaiian
pizza.description: A sweet and savory mix with juicy pineapple chunks, flavorful ham, creamy mozzarella, and tomato sauce. A tropical favorite that perfectly balances sweetness and saltiness.

pizza.name: Veggie
pizza.description: Fresh and colorful, the Veggie pizza is loaded with bell peppers, onions, black olives, and mozzarella on a tomato base. A crunchy and flavorful option, perfect for vegetable lovers.
